title: Playing Hitler's birthday party at Liederkranz Hall in New York
summary: Bourgeois knew Hank Kamen from New York and recalls a German-hall birthday party where the band leader, Lou Lockett, was secretly a Jew.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Oh, I know Hank for quite a while. We worked together in New York. What was that about Hitler's birthday? Oh, we played a birthday party, Hitler's birthday party at the Liederkranz Hall, which is the German hall there. And our leader of the band was a Jew. And if they had known that they'd have thrown him right out of the place. Who was it? Lou Lockett. Of course that wasn't his right name. They thought he was a German or something, huh? Yeah, Lockett, you know, any other, anything else but a Jew.
And we were drinking up the German beer, and it was very excellent, believe me.
But no more of that for you, huh? Oh, I can't drink anymore.
